alternatives.root_cause: Cart's process froze while its socket still accepted, hanging callers.
alternatives.why_not: Callers get immediate connection/host-unreachable and zero-address resolution errors rather than hanging to deadlines (tr_456efddfeeda), and cart logged an orderly shutdown rather than simply going silent (tr_817f9cc6dfdc).

alternatives.root_cause: Cart was cut off from the network by a partition.
alternatives.why_not: A partitioned-but-running cart would keep logging complaints that it cannot reach its own dependencies; instead cart stopped logging entirely after a clean shutdown coincident with an image change (tr_817f9cc6dfdc, tr_2a4e53f10c99).

alternatives.root_cause: Checkout itself broke on the PlaceOrder path.
alternatives.why_not: Checkout has no changes and no sustained error departure, and frontend's errors name the cart endpoint specifically rather than slow checkout work (tr_fcc2b656c545, tr_3bf273e5c4cc, tr_456efddfeeda).

verdict.summary: Cart was repeatedly pointed at a hotfix image that does not come up; at 01:55 the running cart process shut down and the new artifact never started serving, so cart's address became unreachable and checkout/frontend failed on every cart call.
verdict.reasoning: Checkout alerted first but has no changes of its own (tr_fcc2b656c545), no logs in the window (tr_149983e1980b) and no sustained error-ratio departure (tr_3bf273e5c4cc); its traces show healthy, fast dependency spans before onset (tr_f4b637f62239). Frontend's own log shows its failures are connection failures to one downstream address on port 7070 - the cart gRPC endpoint - with no route to host / host unreachable / zero resolved addresses (tr_456efddfeeda), which is a caller symptom, not a frontend fault. Cart's log runs normally until it records an orderly application shutdown just after 01:55 and then stops (tr_817f9cc6dfdc), and the change log shows an image reference flipped onto the same hotfix tag and reverted three times, with the final flip onto that tag at 01:55:19 - exactly coincident with the shutdown and immediately before onset (tr_2a4e53f10c99). A running artifact that is not the one that should be running and that does not come back up is bad_deploy; the dependent blast radius (checkout, frontend, frontend-proxy, load-generator) follows from cart being absent on the checkout path.
open_questions: Cart's logs after the 01:55 shutdown were not inspected for a crash-loop or startup failure of the hotfix image, so I did not directly confirm the new container failed to start rather than being stopped and never rescheduled.
Whether the hotfix image fails for an internal reason (e.g. a bad limit or missing config baked in) was not established.
Checkout's error-ratio metric did not show a sustained departure in the queried window, so the quantitative onset signature on checkout is unconfirmed.
